description: A wide wooden treasure chest seen straight on, filling most of the square, its curved lid thrown open. The chest is warm brown planks with gold corner fittings and a gold lock plate. It is heaped with gold coins, a blue gem set in gold sits on top, a white pearl necklace with a red jewelled pendant drapes over the front, and a silver sword blade with a magenta hilt pokes out of the coins at the right. In front lie a green potion flask, scattered coins, a rolled scroll in a brown case, a small brass oil lamp, a ring, and a gold crown set with blue stones. The background is pure black, making the gold glow; the mood is reward and wealth. Frame 1: a small sparkle glints on the lamp's spout, brief. Frame 2: the sparkle fades and the blue gem dims. Frame 3: a bright white twinkle flashes on the lamp and the gem darkens, held longest. Frame 4: the sparkle vanishes, a flash. The loop reads as the hoard gently twinkling.
title: Open treasure chest overflowing
